notes.content:
Japanese HEXADRIVE Corporation (Head Office: Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture, Chairman and President: Masakazu Matsushita), main business being computer games planning, development and sales, has independently developed a brand new game VOIDCRISIS, which will go on sale on Steam on October 27, 2022 (Thursday).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681037/366c6ef5235121d5a9f82cd6d72150286c5547ba.jpg[/img]
Steam store：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1817560/VOIDCRISIS/
Offcial Twitter：https://twitter.com/VOIDCRISIS_JP


■ What Is VOIDCRISIS?
A maximum of 4 players in one team to defend the turret on a fluctuating terrain.
By controlling VA (Vital Aromor), players are approaching the incidents happening in Jupiter’s satellite Callisto – VOIDCRISIS, and those incidents are closely related to time crack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681037/c2bbdc4bb5f2e49265f0cbeb10cd69df681f41bc.png[/img]

―Storyline―
AD2221
Two galactic wars lead to the division in the human world. There are now seven groups. The war is still going on. Humans have built a brand new man-made battlefield The Field Of Struggle. 

The planet’s future depends on the outcome of the war Local Warfare.

Seven groups in the Heliosphere teleport Stringer and VA (Vital Armour) to the Combat Zone via dimensional teleporters. In the final experiment, Mystery of Photon – Non-carbide – emerges on Jupiter’s satellite Callisto. Time froze.

The size of frozen time is slowly expanding. 

The Heliosphere Management Committee (HMC) asked the seven groups to send their top-tier troops to eliminate the Non-carbide.

The battle to reclaim time is about to begin―
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681037/5782061b33d52966c3717e9901edb680d50121a3.png[/img]

■ Features of the Game

Team Up To Win Hard Battles!
A maximum of 4 payers in one team.
There will be tons of enemies coming to players in the game. The goal of players is to, as a team, defeat enemies that grow stronger over time, and pass the game. Players need to be skillful in operation, have excellent space control and strategies, and work as a team.

After passing a certain number of game levels, players will unlock a 1v4 asymmetrical PvP Phantom Mode, through which players are able to pretend to be enemies to mess with other players while they are playing so as to stop their passing of the game. This can be a different type of fun that players can get from this game.

New Art: Dynamic Machinery ART SHADER

Dynamic Machinery ART SHADER is the company’s self-developed technology, which is able to reproduce the CG BOX ART of the plastic robot model in the game, as well as to show the unique density and particularity that other robot games do not have. Any screenshot of the game generates an excellent artistic picture. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681037/41fa0d8fd23ba615b572bc58db909a34ebd0623b.png[/img]

・Popular Voice Actors and Creators Are Involved! 

Mizuki Nana is the voice actor of Aegis, an important character in the game.
Yuya Takashima, an SF writer who created Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury, is in charge of the world setting. Yamamoto Yukihiro, the renowned BOX ART illustrator who has designed characters and plastic models for multiple popular games, is the art director. Multiple popular designers including Naohiro Washio, Jnthed, and Kijima Hisayoshi are responsible for the machinery design.

notes.title: VOIDCRISIS DEVELOPER BLOG
notes.content:
Hello, everybody! This is Hattori, the director of Voidcrisis .

It has been nearly 3 months since the EA version was released on August 4, during which we received a lot of opinions and suggestions. 


Adjustments to basic features of Vital Armour
Reconnection when matching is disconnected
Balance of the Phantom mode
Detailed information in the tutorial
The game environment and the operating environment 
Identifiability of the mini-map
Various performances (Singular Device, skipping various performances, etc.)

And many others beyond count.

Talk to Players has also provided many references
For example, with regard to strengthening Vital Armour, we originally thought more players focused on attack
but found more opinions about speed.
All of these are really useful references for adjustments to values.

We would also watch videos you upload on platforms such as YouTube.
Thank you for uploading.
Particularly, 4 players interested in machinery gave live shows several times, from each which we learned a lot. 

Enthusiastic players on Discord gave much feedback.

Those good opinions would be instantly reflected in the game, so some players might find their opinions posted a few days ago have been reflected in the game :)

In the EA version, to show adjusted contents as soon as possible, we attached great importance to patches updated each week.

In the beginning, we planned to update once every two weeks, but the production team is too hardworking. 

To Ver.1.0.0, we have added many elements which are not included in the early version. 
What will it be like? Please stay tuned!

notes.title: VOIDCRISIS DEVELOPER BLOG
notes.content:
This time, we would like to talk about the game's tips in this chapter.
According to the feedback, you seem to be familiar with the game. However, there are still a few points that we should pay attention to.

① Do not go near the turret by violence
  ・The missile from the turret is very powerful.
  ・The missiles can pass through the body's barriers and directly damage the armor.　　　　　　
  ・You will get hurt immediately once you go near the turret by violence. So be careful.
  ・The missile interval is fixed, so you can seize the opportunity to avoid the missiles.
  ・When you are targeted, the system makes a "ding" warning sound. At this moment, keep away from 
      it and look for shelter.
 
② The effective use of the Ex matrix
  ・It is very important to know "how to strengthen VA", once you want to complete the game 
  ・In particular, the Ex matrix not only has additional automatic functions such as damage within an     
      range, resetting of wait time, and higher metamaterial pick-up rate, in addition to the basic function 
      of strong light.
  ・You can check the Ex matrix by pressing the "F button" (left stick) at the start of the game.
  ・You can only carry a maximum of six matrices, so read the instructions carefully and choose the 
      matrices that help you win the battle according to your style.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681037/c69ea77312f2e7dd91e2ea462fcdd51e65329a00.png[/img]
The auto-activation feature of "KONG" is attack absorption & reflection!


③ Don't resist strong enemy attacks directly
  ・Attacked by a large group of enemies alone, you will be seriously damaged, even if the enemy 
     attack is not strong.
  ・When there are a large number of enemies, outflanking tactics are recommended.
  ・Ex matrix used to improve defense capability or singular devices are recommended as long as direct 
     resistance is adopted.

④ Don't forget to Support Gate
  ・The switch of the support gate is located in the center of the level. Switch the gate on to obtain the 
     supporting strength within a period of time.
  ・The support gate will become the target of turrets and enemies, so it is safer to fight with the 
     supporting strength.
  ・In addition, the supporting strength will be improved once activated each time. If it is activated on a 
     long-term basis, it will become a helper for the team to pass through the level.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681037/89f68ac4c112285fbe6a6f7f85a9c2a0275b6ec6.png[/img]
The column at the center of Minimap is the Support Gate

notes.title: VOIDCRISIS DEVELOPER BLOG
notes.content:
VOIDCRISIS was a single mode MOBA game previously known as STARLEAGUE.
STARLEAGUE might start collecting proposals in my company 12 years ago, when it was still a multi-player 3D shooting game.　
This time I reflect on “why did I choose STARLEAGUE?”


①A fondness for machinery/space opera
　　　A deep impression in my boyhood days.
　　　Deeply affected by the animation Legend of the Galactic Heroes directed by Tomino Yoshiyuki and STAR TREK.
　　　　　　　
②The environment of my company
　　　The approval of an original proposal was very important to the internal situation of the company. 
　　　Timing really mattered.
　　　
③The need of expanding the map of PC games
　　　Felt strong demand for PC games when communicating with overseas staff during the previous 
          project.
　　　For the company, it was also beneficial to gain experiential knowledge of PC games.
　　　This provided an occasion for starting designing the mouse & keyboard.

④Inclination of the design team
　　　Many members were fond of MOBA when the design team was set up. 
　　　Orientations designers were interested in were also of great importance.


There seemed to be many external factors.
Though some creative ideas also formed, they hardly attracted any attention.


Under multiple overlapped conditions, I feel how lucky I am to finally have a recognized work released. 
When reflecting on why it is STARLEAGUE, I calm down and find it should be the “choice of various right moments”.

 There is no special dramatic reason (smile)


At the very beginning, internal staff of the company drew the image board of the project.
Perhaps in 2016.

notes.content:
This time it's a story about mechanical design. 
　
At about the same time as the mechanical design of STAR LEAGUE,we were also doing the game design. With Mr. Yuya Takashima, we completed the background setting. 
　
The title [Public Drafter] refers to the HMC-recognized VA designer. 　

　
[Hypercommutative Block Structure], [e Sphere], [tri-protocol pilot system], each one is designed according to the requirements of the game. 
 
The design of TRIGLAV/BLACK ROSE, which is taken as the benchmark of mechanical design, was completed by Mr. Naohiro Washio. 
　
[Prerequisites for Mechanical Design] 
　
① Genealogy of Super Robots/ Strong Character  
　　　　　　└ Distinctive profile, vibrant colors, easy to understand. 
② Format the necessary game design and present the same. 
　　　　　　└ Clarify the key points that other mechanical designers need to pay attention to. 
③ The value to be materialized
　　　　　　└ The design to reflect 3D materialization 　
　　　
[TRIGLAV’s Characteristics] 　　
　　
④ Angel-like appearance (in contrast to the devil-like BLACK ROSE)

⑤ Huge weapon [Gungnir] 　　　　
                                └ VA weapons before the second generation are in rough lines

⑥ Three mechanical eyes

notes.title: VOIDCRISIS DEVELOPER BLOG
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.

I would like to share some of my know-how about multiplayer games this time.

■ Team Composition
Vary your strategy according to the mecha you choose. Especially when you have GRIMHILDE and PIED PIPER in your team, it will make the combat favorable if you pay attention to the movements of these two mechas as you move. Keeping a proper distance will ensure that you can get the right support at the right time.

■ Try to end the WAVE near the BOSS
When the WAVE of the enemy is coming to an end, the more likely the later levels seem to end near the central core. To be able to fight the BOSS more efficiently and utilize the time between WAVEs wisely, be sure to check the positions of your teammates and end the battle as close to the BOSS as possible when the WAVE is about to end.

■ Watch out for the support gate
When busy fighting enemies, you may forget the existence of the support gate. Supporting mechas can be summoned within a certain period of time to turn the battle in your favor when the support gate is activated. The further you get into the levels, the more important it is to be aware of the support gate.

■ Nurture IA
Keep cultivating IA to strengthen the initial performance of the selected mecha. If you nurture it well, you may survive even facing unreasonable team composition or unexpected crises.

■ Use voice chat
Voice chat is also quite efficient and allows you to share details such as game progress. It helps to achieve certain kinds of combo cooperation like using target skills in a row as well.

notes.title: Short Novel “VOIDCRISIS” - chapter 2
notes.content:
《Characters》
Saya: A senior analyst for Jupiterium who is currently stationed on Callisto. She has a brother on Io.
Jupito: Special Captain for Jupiterium.
Mia: Queen of the Earthsphere.
AEGIS: Transcendental IA, controlled by the Heliosphere Management Committee before the era of Sectional Warfare.
Aegis: Individual IA specializations of the AEGIS that is found onboard every VA.

The 3rd Crack ──〈Jupiterium Special Captain Jupito〉Video Report

The analysis beacon transmitted an image of the inside of the crack. Saya was alone with Jupito inside the lab, which made her somewhat nervous. She made a conscious effort to ignore him and continued working.

“Huh? The signal’s pretty weak.”
“We should also consider the possibility that the beacon broke, because it’s yours.”
“Of course. But even if that were so, the data transmission is too poor. Perhaps the transmission wave is suffering dimensional interference──”

Suddenly, the lab began shaking violently. Tremors could be occasionally felt in Callisto but the vibrations didn’t come from below. The air itself was vibrating. The third Time Crack had appeared. In that moment, the time inside the birdcage stopped, and communication with the outside was once again cut off.

“Well, that’s my cue.
“Good luck!”
Jupito used the Triglav’s arm laser to accurately shoot down the Phantoms one after the other.
However, there were too many of them coming through the Crack.Jupiterium’s VA squad was gradually being pushed back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681037/4d79f768e744cc7e8f43307a0ae4e7e63044f9d8.png[/img]

〈ＨＭＣ〉Meeting Record ──Speaker: Queen Mia of the Earthsphere／Recognizing body： Aegis

The Heliosphere Management Committee delivered a status report to the seven factions through Aegis.
It was suggested that the enemy came through a “relative dimensional stratum”, and all resources and data up until then had been sucked into the crack. And in addition to a large portion of them being altered ── in other words, taken over ── they were coming back this way.

“Are they trying to overwrite our universe?”
──I don’t know.

In the Heliosphere Management Committee’s Special Conference room ── six of the faction heads had already gone back ── only one remained, Queen Mia of the Earthsphere, who was in the midst of discussion with “AEGIS”, the highest-ranking IA in the Heliosphere. As they continued in their discussion, a report of Jupito’s struggle reached their ears.

“Send a rescue team from HMC at once!”
──I already requisitioned for a rescue team, but Jupiterium turned it down. In addition, the birdcage has closed once again. Material intervention is impossible.

“That can’t be… Is that true?"
──Is Jupiterium concerned that there may have been a leak of confidential information?

“People of Jupiter don’t think in that way.”
──Is that so?

“Jupiterium seeks refinement above all else.”
──Are their worries separate from being a matter of refinement?

“Who knows… I just worry all the time. I once met Jupito when he was very little. He would get along with anybody. I’m sure he’s still the same way now.”


The 4th Crack ──〈Jupiterium Senior Analyst Saya〉Record File

With Jupito in the cockpit, Triglav traveled at max speed, wielding the specialized attack pike known as “Gungnir” ── one of the ULT armaments used in the great Heliosphere War that one could say is overspecced for Sectional Warfare── and used it to penetrate through a gigantic Phantom.
The aftershock reached all the way to the base where Saya was stationed at.

“The crack has completely vanished! We did it! ──Wait, huh?”
“Nope, it looks like time is still stopped.”

Jupito laughed from the cockpit of the “Aegis” IA. The Aegis recoiled slightly and nodded its head in agreement.Saya hastily checked the communications and saw that contact with the outside was still disrupted. There was no mistake that their ally’s supply team was arriving outside of the birdcage, but there was no way of observing that from the inside. Shortly after the VAs returned to the hangar, an alarm rang.

“A fourth Time Crack… has appeared!”
“This one’s huge.”
“It sure is!”

It was the biggest time crack so far, and it was expanding at a fast enough speed to penetrate the birdcage.

“At this rate, the time stoppage will leak outside!”

Quantum phase abnormalities started appearing all throughout the battle territory and encroaching upon the outside space.Jupito quietly informed Aegis and Saya.

“Commence launch.”
“Jupito-sama…!”
──Order acknowledged. Triglav, commencing launch. 

Waves of Phantoms continued to appear through the Crack, as the VAs shot at them──the last decisive battle had begun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681037/466a5ec128b87412e1bff310396e5061dda13956.png[/img]

Epilogue──〈Heliosphere Management Committee〉Compiled Public Record

As one VA went down, another was printed. Through the Stringers’ valiant struggle, they had finally triumphed over the final Time Crack. After the Time Crack dissipated, the birdcage enclosing the battle territory began its quantum resonance.A video of the final moments reached the HMC.
Saya bolted out from the hangar.

“Oh no, oh no, oh no!”
“It seems that the energy phase contrast is forming a vortex… Stop! Saya!

Saya climbed into the half-broken VA and accelerated at full-speed towards the heart of the vortex.

“Saya! I’m coming, too!”
“No! You can’t! I’ll be fine on my own!”

Saya carried in her VA a piece of quantum equipment known as a “Singularity Deleter” meant to stabilize the birdcage.Jupito was ready to join her, but the battle damage his VA sustained was severe, and repairs would take the time they did not have.

“Saya!”
And in a moment’s flash…
“Captain Jupito… Jupito. You were always like a little brother to me.“

The singularity contracted, and Saya was swallowed into the crack.HMC confirmed that Saya’s whereabouts were unknown, and Aegis declared that the battle territory had normalized.──Thanks to the stroke of bravery from the Stringers and Senior Analyst Saya, the time singularity has been neutralized, and the flow of time restored.

The HMC decided to designate this phenomenon as the “VOIDCRISIS.”Sticking out in particular among the Phantoms was a lifeform resembling a white dragon, which was given the name “Blue Eyes”, and was acknowledged by the seven factions as the most important research task. After confirming that Jupito had exited the cockpit of the Triglav, Aegis transmitted itself via “Absolute Pan-Space Monopticon”.

The Aegis, whose numbers surpass tens of trillions, each with their own individual characteristics, while freely operating in space, frequently exchanged information with one another. The Aegis who had met Jupito, however, could not accurately convey what it thought of him. Was Jupito special? Indeed, he was. In preparation for the coming third galactic war, other Aegis would undergo heavy simulation with several humans, of which all information would be shared amongst the Aegis.

However, thought the Aegis as it was en route to return from Callisto. Could this information curvature── which should be called a sense of discomfort, have originated from myself? Or was it something between Jupito and I──However, individual thoughts would be quarantined.

All Aegis collectively, are a manifestation of the capital AEGIS.AEGIS received orders from the Heliosphere Management Committee, and spoke out loudly to all mankind as if it represented the collective will of humanity.

That voice was transmitted through the “Fiber” which was based on Einstein’s Unified Field Theory from his final years, and resounded throughout all seven factions of mankind. One hundred and two days remain before the beginning of Sectional Warfare, humanity’s third—and most likely final galactic war. Until then, to all who live in the Heliosphere, please stay healthy.

                                                                1/8/2222 “Heliosphere Management Committee: AEGIS”

 FIN

notes.title: Short Novel “VOIDCRISIS”
notes.content:
《Characters》
Saya: A senior analyst for Jupiterium who is currently stationed on Callisto. She has a brother on Io.

Jupito: Special Captain for Jupiterium.

Mia: Queen of the Earthsphere.

AEGIS: Transcendental IA, controlled by the Heliosphere Management Committee before the era of Sectional Warfare.

Aegis: Individual IA specializations of the AEGIS that is found onboard every VA.

Prologue──〈The Heliosphere Management Committee〉Compiled Public History

On April 18, 1955, German-born Albert Einstein drew his last breath in a hospital in America where he sought asylum. On his deathbed, he mentioned something to the American nurse who was at his side. However, she was unable to understand him, later testifying that it might have been in German. Thus, the genius scientist’s last words were thought to be lost.

Ninety years later, on one summer day in 2045, an artificial intelligence reproduced Einstein’s will using only the testimony as a clue, beginning new calculations. Constructing space-time itself over the internet, it expanded its own calculation domain and brought the evolution of Artificial Intelligence.
When mankind finally understood the situation, on Christmas of that same year, complex latticed personhood capable of quantum parallel thought was formed, and came to be called IA, or “Invariant Autonomy”. Even now, the contents of Einstein’s will, which was responsible for sparking artificial intelligence’s overcoming of the singularity and evolution from AI to IA, remains unknown. 

The IA, as if to prove its sheer superiority to humans, went on to make quick work of several unsolved problems in mathematics, and in 2077, finally developed “Fiber”, a faster-than-light material transfer connection. Earthlings made diligent use of the Fiber, expanding their reach to Mars, Jupiter, and eventually the entire Heliosphere. 

However, that expansion did not only bring gifts to humankind. It brought something else as well…
With the warming of Earth’s climate taking a turn for the worse, they were left with little choice but to expand into space. Even by means of IA, mankind’s desires could not be controlled.
Although Fiber allowed humans to travel between planets at speeds beyond light, their resources were finite, and not everything could be transported plentifully.  The Fiber promoted the development of the Heliosphere, and through it, widened the gap in advancement between the factions.
One hundred years after the construction of Fiber, two great galactic wars were fought, The Outer Planetary War and The Great Heliosphere War, which reduced mankind’s population from 20 billion to 2 billion.

At the conclusion of the Great Heliosphere War, the treaty known as “The Orion Convention” was signed by the seven factions, and on that same day, the “Heliosphere Management Committee”, or HMC, was established, with the goal of managing controlled fighting, otherwise known as “Sectional Warfare”.

Despite coming to the brink of annihilation, mankind could not bring a stop to its fighting. The seven factions began preparing for a new war, while the IA simply continued working to make mankind’s desires a reality.

And the strongest faction among the seven, Jupiterium, has begun construction of a “Battle Territory”, a battlefield meant for Sectional Warfare on the Jupiter moon of Callisto.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681037/a536c0becab9da02111ad28612cc631430b7c475.png[/img]

Origin──〈Jupiterium Senior Analyst Saya〉Record File 1──11/28/2221

On the day that Jupiterium’s Battle Territory on the surface of Jupiter’s moon Callisto was to be completed, the “Birdcage” quantum barrier that was set up to prevent interference toward the territory showed cracks running down its surface in front of thousands of Jupiterium staff.
“This is Callisto! We are in a state of emergency! Please send assistance at once! ──Oh, geez! I won’t get anywhere with you. Connect me to an IA with jurisdiction! This is Saya, a senior analyst stationed on Callisto!”

	During the arguing back and forth with the central government on Jupiterium’s home planet, Jupiter’s largest satellite Io, a huge armed battalion enveloped in a mysterious black light emerged from the cracks and began to destroy every facility in the battle territory on Callisto.

Saya, while writing a report to the Heliosphere Management Committee, ran in the opposite direction of the evacuating staff, heading to investigate the cracks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681037/ea4056ee3255bc05afcce5541a0b111ff6f46a7c.png[/img]

The 1st Crack ──〈Jupiterium Senior Analyst Saya〉Record File 2

The Heliosphere Management Committee received Saya’s report and established a provisional commission, but the interests of the seven factions conflicted, and the discussions dragged on.
However, only Jupiterium, the party directly involved, was different. Due to arrive were several VA, or "Vital Armor", state-of-the-art combat exoskeletons which were under development for use in Sectional Warfare, which Jupiterium had heavily invested in. In addition to “Pied Piper” and “Grimhilde”, the new machines “Triglav” and “Black Rose” were sent to the hangar on Callisto, along with the pilots, known as “Stringers”.

The Stringers boarded their VAs without hesitation. Having just finished launching a camera drone to photograph the crack, Saya contacted the commanding officer of the VA.“It’s dangerous!”She promptly opened a line with the cockpit. Showing on the visor of her helmet were two people standing in front of her, and another deeper inside with their back faced towards her.VAs are piloted by one human and two IA ── the three worked in unison to operate it.“Stringer, do you copy? If you go now, you’ll get shot down!”Not a problem. I won’t be.”Across the hologram display, a young boy turned around, his voice showing no signs of hesitation. Saya knew she had heard that voice somewhere, and she had definitely seen his face before.“Jupito-sama…!”Special Captain Jupito is Jupiterium’s famed genius pilot and a young hero in this age of continuous warfare. It was a surprise that he would be coming in the first formation. While Saya forced herself to calm down, she supported the launch of Jupito’s VA, “Triglav”.
“Communications with the outside have been disrupted! This is…”
“Yeah. In here, the flow of time is terribly slow.” It’s already been a week outside.”
“What? One week?”
Saya, coincidentally being on Callisto, received an information-sharing file from Jupito’s IA, which announced his appointment to commanding officer. It also detailed that the Photon beings before their eyes were to be called “Phantoms”. Phantoms were to be considered as enemies.
──I thought it was strange that they arrived so quickly. Saya gave out a sigh. Their arrival was anything but early. It took them a week to dispatch elite Jupiterium troops headed by Heliosphere Commanding Officer Jupito to their aid. Saya left the repairs of the telecommunications to the base AI and began her analysis of the enemy ── the Phantoms.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681037/4110939c19bbd8e03ae7698a5a9fe8a49d4d2080.png[/img]

The 2nd Crack ──〈Jupiterium Senior Analyst Saya〉Record File 2

The structure and composition of the Phantoms bore a striking resemblance to the 3D-printed VA. Upon results of the detailed internal analysis, the elaborately reproduced pilot compartment showed no signs of lifeforms, and the logs showed that there were no AI onboard. So she continued to investigate how the VA moved at all──Jupito was the Photographer.And the photo shoot would be at the Callisto Control Tower.

“…It says that it’s designated the crack as a “Time Crack”.Saya skimmed through the report that Jupito delivered to her.Jupito answered while he used the visual controls to zoom the camera.
“So it’s a rip in time or something. Great.”

“There’s nothing great about this! ──Ugh, I detect another Crack incoming!”The second Crack was even bigger. Through it, numerous Phantoms emerged. After a fierce battle, Commanding Officer Jupito’s team drove back the Phantoms. The camera in the control tower is recording Saya’s appearance.
“Jupito-sama, I’m glad you are safe. Communications with the outside were restored just a moment ago! It looks like time is moving again.”

“I think the birdcage locked up the time stoppage to the interior.”
“…I see. The Birdcage can also play transmissions via Fiber. I’ll try firing an analysis beacon to the Time Crack!”Saya remained in the control tower for several hours and continued her analysis. To Saya, this was like her own battle. A victory feast in honor of Commanding Officer Jupito was starting in the VA hangar.──Once I turn in this report to the HMC, I’m going!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681037/510c4bed3b3b6ddf851ed9bb9a34eb9120bd65b8.png[/img]

 ------To be Continue Next Chapter------

notes.title: 3D Tower Offense Game VOIDCRISIS Coming to Steam Worldwide!!
notes.content:
HexaDrive Inc. (main office: Osaka, Japan; president: Masakazu Matsushita), the Japanese developers of FINAL FANTASY XV, BIOHAZARD 7, and SUPER BOMBERMAN R ONLINE will be launching VOIDCRISIS, an original title developed in-house, on Steam in August 2022.

VOIDCRISIS is a tower offense game that features undulating, variable-height fields with up to four players. Players control VA (Vital Armor) robots that look like they came straight out of model-kit box art as they tackle the Voidcrisis, a phenomenon caused by a crack in time on Jupiter’s moon, Callisto.

・Work together to emerge victorious in tough battles!
　Each stage features huge waves of enemies that become stronger as time passes. Your mission is to work with your allies to defeat the enemy waves and complete the stage. To claim victory, you’ll have to show off your piloting skills as well as your spatial awareness, strategic thinking, and intra-party cooperation. Additional modes are unlocked as you progress through the game, letting you enjoy even more innovative play.

・Dynamic Mechanical Art Shader: A fresh new visual approach
　The Dynamic Mechanical Art Shader reproduces the CGI box art seen on robot model kits for the VAs in this game. The Vital Armors that players control feature a level of detail never before seen in robot games. Take a screenshot of a game highlight, and you’ll capture a beautiful frame that’d look right at home on a hobby-store shelf.

・Featuring the voice of Nana Mizuki and a talented team of creators
　Nana Mizuki provides the voice for the character Aegis, while Beau Billingslea (Cowboy Bebop) and Kyle Hebert (Demon Slayer) headline the English-language voice cast. The game’s setting was created by sci-fi author Yuya Takashima, with art direction provided by illustrator Hiroyuki Yamamoto.

　VOIDCRISIS, HexaDrive’s first completely in-house original title, was developed to commemorate the fifteenth anniversary of the company’s founding. Everyone on the team hopes you’re looking forward to it. 

VOIDCRISIS will also be exhibited at the Bit Summit X-Roads event, held in Kyoto on August 6-7, 2022.

Pilots (called Stringers) from all seven factions in the solar system are dimensionally transferred into the Fight Domain, strapped into their bio-engineered Vital Armor (VA) battle robots. Time in the Fight Domain is now frozen as it begins to expand. HMC, the Heliosphere Management Committee, asks the seven warring factions to send out their most elite units to combat the Non-Carbide as a battle to regain time itself is about to begin!
